instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: PropTech startup operating a platform for fractional real estate investment allowing retail investors to invest in commercial properties with as little as €100. With 15,000 registered investors and €25M in funded properties, Vertex navigates complex CMVM regulations governing securities and property investments. The company is currently focused on scaling its operational footprint while maintaining stringent compliance standards for investor protection.
answers.pastInitiatives: A junior engineer built an internal dashboard to visualize our order backlog, which the operations team found useful in identifying bottlenecks. However, this was an informal side project with no official support or maintenance plan, leading to system failure when resources shifted. This experience highlighted a critical need for formalizing idea validation and securing institutional backing before technical development.
answers.strategicGoals: We are targeting a 20% improvement in operational throughput without increasing headcount by focusing intensely on process optimization. Our processes have grown organically over the years and are overdue for standardization, which we suspect workflow digitization and basic automation can unlock significant productivity gains within our current cost structure.
answers.additionalContext: We are in the final stages of being acquired by a larger international group, which provides a significant opportunity for post-acquisition modernization investment. The deal is expected to close in 3 months, allowing us to audit our current state and secure funding for key efficiency projects under the acquirer's umbrella.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: Workflow Digitization via Low-Code Automation
opportunities.rationale: Implementing standardized low-code tools to digitize current manual workflows will immediately address operational bottlenecks and improve throughput without requiring a massive capital outlay. This aligns perfectly with the efficiency goal.

first_actions: Select and pilot one critical workflow (e.g., investor onboarding or property update) for automation using existing low-code tools.
Map out the current 'as-is' process to identify manual handoffs that cause delays.
resources_needed: Small subscription cost for a no-code platform (e.g., Zapier, Airtable Automation)
Founder time commitment for process mapping and oversight.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce average time taken to complete investor onboarding by 30% within the quarter.
milestones: M2: Full operational integration of two key workflows (Month 2).

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Automated Property Sourcing & Diligence Pipeline
opportunities.rationale: Develop a radical AI tool that uses machine learning to scan regional real estate databases, flag high-potential properties based on risk profiles and investor demand signals, and automate the initial document review. This would radically reduce sourcing time and improve deal quality.

first_actions: Identify a narrow dataset of publicly available property listings to train an initial ML model (MVP).
Define key performance indicators for lead qualification accuracy.
resources_needed: Consultant hours or low-cost API access for specialized real estate data feeds.
Funding allocation from the acquirer's potential investment pool.
execution_plan.success_metric: Decrease time spent on property sourcing by 50% and increase qualified lead conversion rate by 15%.
milestones: M1: Prototype ML model trained on pilot data (Months 1-3).
M2: Integration into the core platform with human validation loop (Month 4+).

next_steps.action: Formalize the innovation process by appointing a 'process owner' and defining clear success metrics for efficiency initiatives.
Conduct an immediate audit of all current tech stack components to identify low-hanging fruit for workflow digitization (Incremental).

key_weaknesses: Lack of formalized innovation process, leading to abandoned side projects.
Extremely low digital maturity and reliance on 'one-man' decision-making which limits scaling potential.
High risk associated with owner-alone decision-making during the critical pre-acquisition holding period.
